check: independent verification of the pack-format acceptance entry
method: Read the shipped pack.mcmeta files and searched the live stress log, rather than re-reading the ledger's own wording.

claimsAndResults.claim: no pack-format or incompatible-pack warning appears
claimsAndResults.result: confirmed, zero matching lines in the live stress log

claimsAndResults.claim: the biome pack is registered as NORMAL (opt-in)
claimsAndResults.result: confirmed, the log line reads exactly: Great Wall biome data pack registered as NORMAL (opt-in) (plaincraft_great_wall:great_wall_biome)

whyThisOneMatters: A wrong pack_format is the classic silent failure: the game loads, prints a warning nobody reads, and the data pack is quietly ignored. The claim that there is no warning is therefore a real acceptance property rather than a formality, and it holds in the live run.
